# Material Color Utilities subset

Source: https://github.com/material-foundation/material-color-utilities/tree/main/java

Retrieved 2026-10-25 through the GitHub connector. The original Google LLC copyright headers and Apache-2.0 license are retained. Only HCT, its color/math dependencies, and TonalPalette are included, without source changes. File hashes are recorded in `SHA256SUMS` to identify this snapshot independently of upstream branch changes.

The APK also contains the license at `assets/licenses/material-color-utilities.txt`.
